inlines.v: INDISTINCT'LY, adverb Without distinction or separation; as when parts of a thing are indistinctly seen. 1. Confusedly; not clearly; obscurely; as when ideas are indistinctly comprehended. 2. Not definitely; not with precise limits; as when the border of a thing is indistinctly marked.
